name: Nation Gold Corp.
summary: Nation Gold Corp. is involved in the identification, acquisition, and development of mineral resource properties, with a particular focus on locating gold and silver deposits. Its portfolio includes the wholly-owned Cattle Creek property. This asset, covering 539.16 hectares across four mineral claims, is located in the southern Monashee Pass area of British Columbia, within the Vernon Mining Division. The company was established in 2017 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
